name: Ip~pai Amaete ne♪ ~Chiisaku Natte Yasashii Kasumi Onee-chan ni Osewa Saretsukusu Iyasare Kozukuri~
original_name: いっ～ぱい甘えてね♪ ～小さくなって優しいかすみお姉ちゃんにお世話され尽くす癒され子作り～
source:
Knowing each other since their childhood years, the protagonist is like a little brother to the three sisters who live next-door.
He is shy, and to fix this the second girl invented a cure drug. However, it went wrong and the protagonist becomes small!
The three sisters loves him, and proposes to let him choose the one that will take care of him until he regains his previous figure.

This time, the eldest sister, Kasumi, looks after you. Beautiful and full of motherliness, she loves you unconditionally.
Enjoy the child-making life with this gentle woman! 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE109460.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
主角从小就认识，对住在隔壁的三姐妹就像弟弟一样。
他很害羞，为了解决这个问题，第二个女孩发明了一种治疗药物。然而出了问题，主角变小了！
三姐妹爱他，提议让他选择一个能照顾他的人，直到他恢复原来的身材。

这次由大姐霞照顾你。美丽且充满母性，她无条件地爱你。
和这个温柔的女人一起享受生孩子的生活吧！

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE109460.html]DLsite English[/url]]
